identity.operation: Dump a value loaded by json_loadb through do_dump.
identity.capability: do_dump returns failure at the depth limit.
identity.consequence: A depth-limit rejection cannot be exercised if json_loadb does not admit a value that reaches it.

requirement: For a reachable value at the depth limit, dumping must return failure.

assessment.necessity_reason: For every value json_loadb accepts, the old harness invokes a dump mode that delegates to do_dump. If an accepted value reaches the depth limit, the existing route exercises the guard. Whether such a value is accepted remains unknown.

before.requirement: Return failure at the specified dump depth limit.
before.reason: The complete old do_dump body has no depth-limit guard.

after.requirement: Return failure when dumping a loaded value reaches JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH.
after.reason: The new guard returns failure. The old harness sends every successfully loaded value to json_dumps or json_dump_callback, both of which reach do_dump. Parser depth handling is needed to determine whether a valid fuzz input can reach the guard.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Callback dumping invokes do_dump at depth zero.
String dumping delegates to callback dumping.
Parser acceptance depends on parse_value, whose body was not supplied.

assessment.comparison_reason: The failure guard was added after the change, and the same old harness already routes accepted values through it. Reachability from valid input is unresolved, but no blocked harness route is established for this frozen obligation.
missing_information: Complete before and after bodies of src/load.c::parse_value, src/load.c::parse_array, and src/load.c::parse_object, including their depth checks.
The definition and configured value of JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH.

necessity_evidence.reason: The new dump depth guard is within the target’s load-then-dump surface. The packet does not establish whether a valid input can produce a value that reaches it. If one can, the existing harness already routes that value through the guard; if none can, the packet does not establish whether the supported depth rejection is blocked by the target’s setup.

scope_contract.reason: The target dumps values returned by json_loadb, and the changed do_dump contract rejects traversal at JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH.

feasible_trigger.reason: json_loadb delegates value construction to parse_value. Its depth rules and the configured limit are absent, so no finite valid input reaching the dump limit is established.

observable_consequence.reason: The guard returns failure at the limit, but whether the target’s load-only object setup prevents that supported rejection from being exercised is unresolved. The harness has no existing assertion about the dump result.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: Counterevidence supplies a direct route for every accepted value: both dump modes reach do_dump. Whether an accepted value can reach the limit remains unknown, so that route does not yet settle coverage.

evidence.dependency_reason: String dumping delegates to callback dumping.

identity_preserved.reason: The before and after comparison concerns the same load-then-dump depth-limit rejection. The complete old do_dump body lacks the guard; the after body adds it. No separate old defect is substituted.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Parser acceptance determines which loaded values can be dumped.

missing_information: Complete before and after src/load.c::parse_value, src/load.c::parse_array, and src/load.c::parse_object bodies, including depth checks.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: do_dump returns failure when traversal reaches JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH.
coverage_witness.required_setup: A valid json_t value whose dump traversal reaches the configured depth limit.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The entry obtains json_t only from json_loadb and dumps it if loading succeeds.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: Potential inability to exercise depth-limit rejection if json_loadb rejects every value that would reach it.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: Both existing dump modes reach do_dump for accepted values; whether any accepted value reaches the limit is unresolved.
